sentences.text:
Parineeta Pandey .....Applicant(s) Versus State Of U.P. And 3 Others .....Opposite Party(s)
Counsel for Applicant(s) :
Chandra Bhushan Dhar Dubey, Yogesh Kumar Tripathi Counsel for Opposite Party(s)
Heard Sri Yogesh Kumar Tripathi, learned counsel for applicant and Shri Imran Khan, learned AGA for the State.

2. The instant transfer application has been filed by the applicant with a prayer to transfer the Case no. 10815 of 2022 (State versus Rajani Kant Tripathi & others), Case Crime no. 07 of 2022, under Sections 498-A, 323, 504 I.P.C. & 3/4 D.P. Act, Police Station Surajpur, District Gautam Buddh Nagar, pending in the Court of learned A.C.J.M.-II, Gautam Buddh Nagar to any court in District Gorakhpur having competent jurisdiction.
3.

entities.text: Case no. 10815 of 2022 (State versus Rajani Kant Tripathi & others), Case Crime no. 07 of 2022
entities.label: PRECEDENT

sentences.text: At the very outset, learned counsel for applicant submits, however, applicant is the wife of the opposite party no.2 and she filed the instant transfer application with the prayer to transfer the trial of the case relates to offence under Section 498A IPC from District Gautam Buddh Nagar to District Gorakhpur but now applicant is ready to appear through video conferencing and, therefore, instant transfer application may be disposed of with the direction that if applicant filed an application before appropriate forum to appear through Video Conferencing then his application shall be entertained and she will be permitted to appear through Video Conferencing.
4. Learned A.G.A. is having no objection.

5. In view of the contention raised by learned counsel for the applicant, instant transfer application stands disposed of with the direction that if applicant filed an application to pursue the matter through Video Conferencing then his application shall be considered and she will be permitted to pursue the matter through Video Conferencing.

(Sameer Jain,J.) November 7, 2025 Anurag/-
